item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas—Regardless of what year it is, the Northwestern State 4×400 relay remains the bread and butter of a powerful track and field program. item.title: Inconsistent Lady Demons fall at UIW
item.description: SAN ANTONIO – The Northwestern State women’s basketball team struggled to find consistency with the basketball in hand on Saturday, leading to a 66-53 loss to UIW.
